body_markdown:
Pickle lovers, you haven’t seen anything yet in the realm of creative pickle combos. Pickle obsession runs deep these days, but Lifeway is here to take things up a notch beyond a standard snack plate. That’s why we’ve rounded up some of our best cultured, protein-packed, probiotic pickle creations for you to explore. Whether you’re sipping a tangy morning smoothie, or in the mood for a creamy, crunchy dip, these pickle recipes with Lifeway prove that healthy eating and dill-icious cravings can live in gut-healthy harmony.


## 4 Gut-Healthy Pickle Recipes with Lifeway Kefir and Farmer Cheese


Whether you choose our creamy, probiotic[Lifeway Kefir](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/what-is-kefir) or our[high-protein Lifeay Farmer Cheese](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/lifewayfarmercheese) , there’s a tangy, gut-healthy option from Lifeway that’s sure to pair perfectly with your go-to pickle eats. Our kefir and farmer cheese are fermented with live, active cultures that deliver premium[probiotic support](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/probiotics) and complete protein since they’re made with real milk. Nutrient-rich and versatile, Lifeway products go with[just about anything you can dream up](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/recipes) . Don’t believe us? Perk up your probiotic routine with these pickle recipes below!


### 1.[Pickle Smoothie](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/picklesmoothie/)


Each nourishing sip of our Pickle Kefir Smoothie is tart and softly sweet with underlining notes of vibrant dill flavor. This unique, herbal masterpiece is made by blending Lifeway Kefir with fermented pickles and sweet mango and banana. Besides packing a probiotic punch to support your gut, the naturally tangy taste of Lifeway Kefir complements the other ingredients perfectly, creating a flawless smoothie treat. **[Recipe Here](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/picklesmoothie/)**


### 2.[Dill Pickle Pasta Salad](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/dill-pickle-pasta-salad/)


Loaded with protein and probiotics from[Lifeway Kefir](https://lifewaykefir.com/products/plain-lowfat-kefir/) and[Lifeway Farmer Cheese](https://lifewaykefir.com/products/cheese-farmer-cheese/) , this easy Dill Pickle Pasta Salad has a bold, undeniable pickle flavor that’s simply a must-try. Rotini pasta in this recipe is the perfect shape, since it holds up well to the dressing by helping it cling onto each piece of pasta just right. **[Recipe Here](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/dill-pickle-pasta-salad/)**


### 3.[Fried Pickle Dip](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/fried-pickle-dip/)


Our Fried Pickle Dip might just be one of the most fun, fermented, flavorful appetizers we’ve created yet. This pickle dip recipe is filled with the zippy, briny taste pickles are known for in a high-protein, creamy base made from Lifeway Farmer Cheese, seasonings, and pickle juice. When paired with some savory crackers or pretzels of your choosing, this simple, unique recipe is sure to be a party favorite. **[Recipe Here](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/fried-pickle-dip/)**


### 4.[Farmer Cheese Stuffed Pickles](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/farmer-cheese-stuffed-pickles/)


Change up your snack routine with our Farmer Cheese Stuffed Pickles made with high-protein, probiotic Lifeway Farmer Cheese, ground turkey, pickles, onions, and a collection of spices. This dish is a low-carb, high-protein snack and one supreme recipe you’ll love for your tailgating spread. **[Recipe Here](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/farmer-cheese-stuffed-pickles/)**


If you try one of these recipes, snap a photo, and[tag us @LifewayKefir on Instagram](http://www.instagram.com/lifewaykefir) with the hashtag #LifewayLovesYourGuts so we can see. 💙
